subject: Group showcase: resolving double-book & compressed slot options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@acme.co>, Priya Rao <priya@bluebird.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Group showcase: resolving double-book & compressed slot options

Hi Sam and Priya,

Thanks for your interest in a group walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We have two overlapping prospect requests for the same week (Acme + Bluebird) and a tight host calendar. Rather than run two full 45–60 minute demos, I wanted to propose a compressed 30-minute group session that covers the core performance & integration story, followed by optional 15-minute breakout rooms for technical deep-dive (hosted by Neha and our infra engineer).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 2027-12-21, 10:30–11:00 (host: Marcus / backup: Lauren)
- Wed 2027-12-22, 13:00–13:30 (host: Marcus / backup: Neha)
- Thu 2027-12-23, 08:30–09:00 (host: Lauren / backup: Marcus)

Quick asks: please reply with the one slot that works best for you, or tell us if you must have a dedicated 45–60 minute meeting instead. If the compressed format is OK we will send a combined calendar invite + breakout invites and the deck (attached).

Attachments: redwood-intro-deck-v2.pdf, calendar invite stub.

Cheers,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

On 2027-12-19 09:12, Marcus Lin wrote:
> Hi Sam and Priya,
> 
> Thanks for your interest in a group walkthrough of Redwood Inference...

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the proactive approach. Tue 12/21 at 10:30 PT works fine for our team (I can join the breakout for the integration questions). If you anticipate heavy technical detail, we might request the 45-minute dedicated session, but let’s try the compressed slot first.

Sam

From: Priya Rao <priya@bluebird.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sam Wells <sam.wells@acme.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Group showcase: resolving double-book & compressed slot options

Marcus — thanks. We’re interested but have two folks who can’t make 12/21 morning. Can you do Wed 12/22 at 13:00 PT? If we go with the 30-minute format, could you record the main session and share the recording and slides? Also please include a quick note in the invite who to ping for post-demo follow-ups (pricing/benchmarks).

If 12/22 is impossible, we’ll propose an internal time and flag availability.

— Priya

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-19T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: internal: Group showcase coordination (Acme + Bluebird)

Internal thread — quick ops notes:
- 12/22 13:00 PT is free on our side; I can cover the host role if Marcus needs to hop between prospects.
- Recommend structure: 25 min main demo (inc. 2 slides on performance/cost), 15 min parallel breakouts (Neha takes infra/quantization; Marcus takes integration/SDK). This keeps the main session crisp and gives both buyers the deep dive they want.
- Neha, can you have a short checklist (1 pager) on what we’ll show in the breakout (KV cache, batching, routing policy examples)? I’ll prepare a shortened deck with a 2-slide appendix per deep-dive.
- We should send a single calendar invite with 2 optional breakout links (Zoom + breakout bridge). Also flag that a recording will be available.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@acme.co>, Priya Rao <priya@bluebird.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Group demo scheduled (12/22 13:00 PT) + breakout plan

Hi Sam & Priya — thanks for the quick replies and flexibility. We’ll run the compressed group demo on:

Wed, 2027-12-22 | 13:00–13:30 PT (Main session)
Optional breakouts: 13:30–13:45 PT (Breakout A: infra deep-dive with Neha; Breakout B: integration/SDK with Marcus)

I attached the shortened deck and the calendar invite (group-demo-calendar.ics). Lauren will host the main session, I’ll run Breakout B, Neha will run Breakout A. We’ll record the main session and share the recording + slides within 24 hours.

If either of you needs a full 45–60 minute dedicated session instead, tell us and we’ll schedule a follow-up. Otherwise, please accept the calendar invite.

Next steps:
- Accept calendar invite (sent)
- If you want the NDA in advance, I can push a DocuSign link — otherwise we’ll share slides + recording after the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marcus
